b2-boliviaaltiplano-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Lake That Keeps the Frost Away
b2-boliviaaltiplano-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Lake Titicaca, and he asks why families can grow crops by the lake.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-01.prompt: Tell Carlos which families can grow potatoes and barley, and why.
cues: Say that the lake softens the frosts
b2-boliviaaltiplano-01.target: Las familias que viven cerca del lago pueden cultivar papa porque el agua suaviza las heladas.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-01.english: The families who live near the lake can grow potatoes because the water softens the frosts.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-01.canDo: I can describe the high plateau and Lake Titicaca with relative clauses introduced by *que* and *quien*.

b2-boliviaaltiplano-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Mint Is Now a Museum
b2-boliviaaltiplano-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip to Potosí, and she asks what is left of the Mint.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-02.prompt: Tell Meg what the Mint of Potosí is today.
cues: Say that the Mint is a museum now
Say what it was used for
b2-boliviaaltiplano-02.target: Hoy la Casa de la Moneda está convertida en museo, y allí se acuñaban monedas de plata.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-02.english: Today the Mint is turned into a museum, and silver coins were minted there.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-02.canDo: I can say what Potosí looks like today with *estar* + participle.

b2-boliviaaltiplano-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Not a District, a City
b2-boliviaaltiplano-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading an article about La Paz and El Alto, and he thinks El Alto is a district of La Paz.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-03.prompt: Correct Carlos: El Alto is not a district.
cues: Reject the idea that it is a district
Say what El Alto really is
b2-boliviaaltiplano-03.target: No es que El Alto sea un barrio de La Paz, sino que es una ciudad con su propio gobierno.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-03.english: It is not that El Alto is a district of La Paz; it is a city with its own government.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-03.canDo: I can correct a wrong idea about La Paz and El Alto with *no es que… sino que…*.

b2-boliviaaltiplano-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Government Says About Coca
b2-boliviaaltiplano-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a talk about the coca leaf, and she asks what the Bolivian government says.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-04.prompt: Tell Meg the government's position, naming the source.
cues: Say that coca is not cocaine
b2-boliviaaltiplano-04.target: El gobierno boliviano dice que la coca tiene usos tradicionales y que no es cocaína.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-04.english: The Bolivian government says that coca has traditional uses and that it is not cocaine.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-04.canDo: I can say who says what about the coca leaf, using *según* and *dice que*.

b2-boliviaaltiplano-05.title: Communicative Challenge: However Much It Is Discussed
b2-boliviaaltiplano-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a talk about the Constitution of 2009, and he asks which languages it recognises.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-05.prompt: Tell Carlos the languages are official in spite of the debate.
cues: Grant that Spanish is spoken in the cities
Say that the indigenous languages are official too
b2-boliviaaltiplano-05.target: Por más que se hable castellano en las ciudades, los idiomas indígenas también son oficiales.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-05.english: However much Spanish is spoken in the cities, the indigenous languages are official too.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-05.canDo: I can grant a point and still state my main idea with *por más que* + subjunctive.

b2-boliviaaltiplano-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bolivian Highlands in Review
b2-boliviaaltiplano-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk about the Bolivian highlands, and she asks where Titicaca lies.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg which lake Bolivia shares with Peru.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-consolidation.target: El lago Titicaca es el lago que Bolivia comparte con Perú.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-consolidation.english: Lake Titicaca is the lake that Bolivia shares with Peru.
b2-boliviaaltiplano-consolidation.canDo: I can review what I learned about the Bolivian highlands, from Lake Titicaca to the Constitution of 2009.
